title: Sculptures
fullDescription: A curated collection of six intricate sculptures, realized through a blend of traditional artistic principles and contemporary digital sculpting techniques using ZBrush, 3ds Max, and Photoshop. These personal works explore philosophical themes and narratives drawn from fiction and observations of the world. Turntable videos provide a comprehensive 360° view, highlighting the texture, intricate details, and overall form of each piece.

process.title: Inspiration & Conceptualization
process.description: Drawing inspiration from fiction, philosophical concepts, and observations of the world, I translated these ideas into initial sketches and conceptual explorations to envision each sculpture's narrative.

process.title: Digital Sculpting & Refinement
process.description: Utilizing ZBrush and 3ds Max, I meticulously sculpted detailed 3D models, focusing on the interplay of forms, textures, and overall composition to bring the initial concepts to life.

process.title: Rendering & Visual Presentation
process.description: Final rendering was achieved using V-Ray with simple lighting and shading techniques to highlight the sculptural qualities. Fume FX was employed to create atmospheric effects such as smoke and water, enhancing the visual narrative.
